title: bb-utils parameters
description: Summarise, prune and update a BigBacter database

db.description: BigBacter database (local path, s3://, gs:// or az://).

outdir.description: Where reports and manifests are written.

dry_run.description: remove/push: report what would happen and change nothing.

threads.description: Parallel list, copy and delete operations.

taxa.description: Taxon. remove: exactly one (required). summary/push: optional, comma-separated. Cleaned the same way as BigBacter (non-alphanumeric characters become '_').

cluster.description: Cluster. remove: one cluster; on its own it removes the whole cluster. summary: optional, comma-separated.

samples.description: Comma-separated sample names, or a file with one name per line. Needs --cluster.

added_after.description: Remove samples added at or after this time (Unix seconds, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS; UTC).

added_before.description: Remove samples added before this time (Unix seconds, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS; UTC).

prune_empty.description: Delete clusters that are left with no samples, including their reference.

overwrite.description: Replace sample files that are already in the database. References and config.json are never replaced.

allow_missing_sig.description: Push samples that have no signature in the run (clusters set in the samplesheet).
